description: A macro-counting fitness guru only eats salmon and eggs. Each bowl of salmon contains 300 calories, 15 grams of protein, and 80 mg of sodium. Each bowl of eggs contains 200 calories, 8 grams of protein, and 20 mg of sodium. Since the fitness guru has a limit to how many eggs he would like to eat, at most 40% of his meals can be eggs. The fitness guru needs to eat at least 2000 calories and 90 grams of protein. How many of each type of meal should he eat to minimize his sodium intake?

CaloriePerBowl.definition: Calorie content per bowl for each food type

ProteinPerBowl.definition: Protein content per bowl for each food type

SodiumPerBowl.definition: Sodium content per bowl for each food type

MaxMealProportionEggs.definition: Maximum proportion of meals that can be eggs

objective.description: "Minimize the total sodium intake from consuming salmon and eggs"

constraints.description: Total calories from salmon and eggs must be at least 2000
Total protein from salmon and eggs must be at least 90 grams
The number of egg bowls consumed must be at most 40% of the total number of bowls consumed
The number of salmon bowls consumed and the number of egg bowls consumed must be non-negative

Meals.definition: Number of bowls consumed for each food type
